title: confiture migrate steps --format json
description: The online runner's checkpoints (issue #200): one row per (migration, plan, stage) in `<tracking_table>_steps`, and the version `--resume` continued, if any.

migration.description: The migration version the stage belongs to.

plan_index.description: Which staged plan of the migration (a file with several multi-step statements has several).

state.description: `running`: started and not finished — after a crash, the stage to resume from. `done`: finished. `failed`: its statement or batch raised.

batch_cursor.description: The backfill's last committed batch position; null for a DDL stage.

updated_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of the last change to the row.

resumed.description: The version `--resume` continued to completion, or null.
